newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Stewart Enterprises started.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Stewart Enterprises started.

text.p: -- Rodman & Renshaw Inc Tuesday initiated coverage of Stewart Enterprises Inc with a buy rating and a price target of $43 a share.
-- Rodman analyst Jennifer Childe said she expects consistent and sustainable stock price appreciation of 20 percent or more, in line with the company's historical and projected growth rate.

-- Stewart, which operates 308 funeral homes and 120 cemeteries in 22 states and six countries, has a backlog of about $800 million in sales, nearly four years worth of anticipated revenue at today's levels, Childe said.
-- Childe said two of Stewart's competitors have about two years of anticipated revenues.
-- The deathcare company's stock was trading up 3/4 at 37.
